sources.quote: remaining performance obligations were $4.1 billion as of December 31, 2025, of which the Company expects to recognize approximately 38% as revenue over the next 12 months, 36% as revenue

sources.label: Contract liabilities
sources.locator: Item 8 · Note 3 Contract liabilities and remaining performance obligations
sources.quote: As of December 31, 2025 and 2024, the Company’s contract liabilities were $812.3 million and $566.4 million, respectively.

sources.label: Total remaining deal value
sources.quote: the total remaining deal value of the contracts, as defined above, was $11.2 billion, up 105% from December 31, 2024, when our total remaining deal value of such contracts was $5.4 billion.

sources.label: Remaining deal value by customer type
sources.quote: $6.8 billion was the remaining deal value of our contracts with commercial customers and $4.4 billion was the remaining deal value of our contracts with government customers.

sources.label: Total remaining deal value definition
sources.quote: Total remaining deal value presumes the exercise of all contract options available to our customers and no termination of contracts.

sources.label: Contribution definition
sources.locator: Item 8 · Note 13 Segment and Geographic Information
sources.quote: A segment’s contribution is calculated as segment revenue less the related costs of revenue and sales and marketing expenses.

sources.label: Contract liabilities definition
sources.locator: Item 8 · Note 3 Contract liabilities and remaining performance obligations
sources.quote: The Company’s contract liabilities consist of deferred revenue and customer deposits.

sources.label: RPO definition
sources.locator: Item 8 · Note 3 Contract liabilities and remaining performance obligations
sources.quote: Revenue allocated to remaining performance obligations represents noncancelable contracted revenue that has not yet been recognized

sources.label: Revenue growth risk
sources.quote: we may not be able to sustain our revenue growth;

sources.label: Customer concentration risk
sources.quote: a limited number of customers account for a substantial portion of our revenue;

sources.label: Deal value risk
sources.quote: we may not realize the full deal value of our customer contracts;

sources.label: Termination for convenience
sources.quote: many of our customer contracts may be terminated by the customer at any time for convenience

sources.label: Public sector risk
sources.quote: we may fail to receive and maintain government contracts or there may be changes in the contracting or fiscal policies of the public sector;

sources.label: Voting control
sources.quote: the multi-class structure of our common stock, the Founder Voting Trust Agreement, and the Founder Voting Agreement concentrate voting power with certain stockholders

sources.label: Receivables concentration
sources.locator: Item 8 · Note 2 Concentrations of credit risk
sources.quote: Customer I represented 25% and 26% of total accounts receivable as of December 31, 2025 and 2024, respectively

sources.label: Revenue concentration
sources.locator: Item 8 · Note 2 Concentrations of credit risk
sources.quote: For the years ended December 31, 2025, 2024, and 2023, no customer represented 10% or more of total revenue.

sources.label: Cloud hosting commitment
sources.quote: Under one of its third-party cloud services agreements, as amended, the Company has committed to spend at least $1.95 billion over ten contract years through September 30, 2033

sources.label: No outstanding debt balances
sources.quote: As of December 31, 2025, we had no outstanding debt balances and additional available and undrawn revolving commitments of $500.0 million under our credit facility.

sources.label: Adjusted income from operations, definition
sources.quote: We use the non-GAAP measures contribution margin; gross profit and gross margin, excluding stock-based compensation; and adjusted income from operations, which excludes stock-based compensation and related employer payroll taxes

sources.label: Stock-based compensation is noncash
sources.quote: We exclude stock-based compensation, which is a noncash expense, from these non-GAAP financial measures
